node.title: Re^3: Windows / Linux puzzler
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I like your first suspicion more than your second.

Sorry, but personally I find the AM's first suggestion less likely, [doc://time] should be portable across platforms, and it being off by an entire minute would be an obvious problem. I do think you should investigate the values of your variables on both platforms though: output them via [doc://Data::Dumper] with $Data::Dumper::Useqq=1; or [mod://Data::Dump] (see also the [id://745674]).
